appDesc.message: Graphic & parametric EQ for tab audio: spectrum analyzer, level-matched A/B, AutoEQ import. Private, no network access.

powerTitle.message: Turn the equalizer on for this tab

help3.message: Knobs: drag vertically or scroll; click the value to type it (e.g. «2.5k»)

help5.message: Double-click: point, knob or fader back to default

help6.message: A/B: hold to listen without EQ, Shift+click to lock it

anSmoothingTitle.message: 0 = no averaging; higher values = steadier but slower spectrum

clipTitle.message: Clip: the signal reached 0 dBFS. Click to reset

abHoldTitle.message: Hold to listen without EQ · Shift+click to lock the bypass

abLockedTitle.message: Bypass locked: click to turn the EQ back on

limiterTitle.message: Output limiter: prevents distortion when you boost a lot

errBusy.message: This tab is already being captured by another extension (maybe another equalizer).

errInvoke.message: Reopen the popup from the tab you want to equalize and try again.

typeHint_peaking.message: boosts or cuts a range around the frequency

typeHint_lowshelf.message: boosts or cuts everything below the frequency

typeHint_highshelf.message: boosts or cuts everything above the frequency

typeHint_highpass.message: removes everything below the frequency (e.g. rumble)

typeHint_notch.message: removes a narrow band (e.g. a hum or a whistle)

typeHint_bandpass.message: lets through only a band around the frequency

noSpectrum.message: Turn the EQ on to see this tab's spectrum

modeParametricTitle.message: Free bands with frequency, gain and Q: for precise corrections. It's the same EQ: your curve carries over

approxWarn.message: 10 sliders can only approximate this curve (up to $1 dB off). Switch back without moving them to get your original bands.

siteRemembered.message: Settings remembered for $1 · click to forget

siteNA.message: Site memory is not available on this page

importStep1.message: Open autoeq.app and choose your headphones

importStep3.message: Click Download, then open the file here with Open file…

importTitle.message: Import a headphone profile (AutoEQ / Equalizer APO)

importHint.message: You can also paste the text of any Equalizer APO parametric file (up to 10 filters).

importDone.message: Imported $1 filters. Save them as a preset to keep them.

importPartial.message: Imported $1 of $2 filters (max 10, unknown types skipped).

matchABTitle.message: When you listen to B, its volume is matched to the EQ so you compare the sound, not the loudness
